business_summary: Takara & Company Ltd. produces, consults, prints, and translates disclosure and IR-related materials in Japan and internationally. The company offers project proposal, design creation, proofreading, printing, electronic, and other services for statutory disclosure documents; and voluntary disclosure documents created for shareholders and investors. It is also involved in the provision of support services for general shareholders meetings; creation of examples; and provision of various information and seminars for persons in charge of disclosure, as well as for acquiring certifications. In addition, the company offers automation tools; WizLaboBudget, a budget management support tool; support services for the preparation of listing application documents required for initial public offering companies and support for audit responses; and advisory services related to the creation of ESG and integrated reports that create corporate social value, as well as develops applications and systems, corporate sites, such as ER/SR tools. Further, it provides support services for the transition to IFRS disclosure; disclosure of corrections and settlement of accounts and early settlement of accounts; advisory services, such as M&A support and listing examinations services on the TOKYO PRO Market; translation services covering a range of fields, including translation of confidential information and IR materials related to M&A; localization services; and support for customers global business development. Additionally, the company develops and sells AI translation systems, and support in setting up the translation environment. Takara & Company Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Takara & Company Ltd.는 일본 및 해외의 공시 및 IR 관련 자료를 제작, 컨설팅, 인쇄 및 번역합니다. 회사는 법정 공시 문서에 대한 프로젝트 제안, 디자인 작성, 교정, 인쇄, 전자 및 기타 서비스를 제공합니다. 주주 및 투자자를 위해 작성된 자발적 공개 문서. 또한 주주총회 지원 서비스 제공에도 참여하고 있습니다. 예제 생성; 공시담당자를 대상으로 각종 정보와 세미나를 제공하고, 자격증 취득도 가능합니다. 또한 회사는 자동화 도구를 제공합니다. 예산 관리 지원 도구인 WizLaboBudget; 기업공개에 필요한 상장신청서류 준비 및 감사 대응 지원 서비스 기업의 사회적 가치를 창출하는 ESG 및 통합보고서 작성과 관련된 자문 서비스는 물론, 애플리케이션 및 시스템 개발, ER/SR 툴 등 기업 사이트 개발 등을 수행하고 있습니다. 또한 IFRS 공개로의 전환을 위한 지원 서비스를 제공합니다. 정정·결산공시 및 조기결산
